notes:
### Fixes

- A request that Antigravity, Codex Desktop, DeepSeek Harness or the Claude desktop app asks in its own window keeps its card until the client stops asking. The card used to leave for good after the wait time (10 minutes by default) while the client still waited, so a question asked earlier never showed again.
- Antigravity: a turn shows as soon as its prompt is written, before any reply. Web Remote hid such a turn, prompt included, until a text reply came.
- Web Remote: pictures that Antigravity links as `file://` addresses show, and so do pictures under Windows drive paths.
- Web Remote: the sidebar lists every folder, without the show-all button.
- Settings → Web Remote says which way needs a subscription: through the relay from anywhere needs Agent HUD Remote; on the local network and over Tailscale needs none.
